# Vendor specifications

| Vendor | Document | Status |
|---|---|---|
| PayFlux | Webhook API **v3** specification (`payflux-v3.md`) | **Not received.** Requested 2025-02-20 under NDA; vendor ETA unknown. |

The PayFlux v2 webhook format is deprecated and incompatible with v3 (different signature scheme
and event names). Do not implement against v2 or against guesses about v3.
